test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

The tournament __have been cancel__.

options.text:
No substitution required

×

duplicate options found. English Question 1 options 2,3

solution: The correct answer is **'has been cancelled'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'has been cancelled'** should be used instead of **'have been cancelled'.** • In the given sentence **'the tournament' **is **a singular subject**. Hence, **a singular helping verb** should be used. • The given sentence is in the **passive voice.** • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.** **Correct Sentence:__** *The tournament has been cancelled.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां, **'have been cancelled'** के बजाय **'has been cancelled'** का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • दिए गए वाक्य में** 'the tournament' **एक **singular subject **है। इसलिए, **singular helping verb** का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • दिया गया वाक्य **passive voice **में है। • अत: सही उत्तर **Option 4** है। 33:Ta9e, The erroneous spelling is '**Crystle**'.
